pages.title: Episode 3, Page 1-2
pages.text: Episode 3, Page 1-2 is the shortest of the Comix Zone page songs, under a minute before it starts over. It belongs to the page of reefs and caves in the Zealand atolls, where Sketch Turner grumbles, "Man, I hate seafood!"

pages.title: Pelagus
pages.text: Hardcore Gaming 101 calls Pelagus, a rare enemy in Comix Zone, a "mini-Cthulhu." It spits bouncing slime and lays mines that can blow away about half of Sketch Turner's health.

pages.title: Two megabytes
pages.text: Programmer Adrian Stephens had to fit Comix Zone into a two-megabyte cartridge and still unpack big comic pages of graphics during play. The Genesis wasn't designed for that, he said, but he made it work.
